text_block_list.text:
Well, you see... El was talking in her
sleep last
night, and I couldn't help but
be a little curious...
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
She must've been having the buffet of
her
dreams, because she kept calling out
things like
"a la plancha" and
"gazpacho."
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
It's incredible how she can muster that
much
energy even while sleeping...
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: So you see, I didn't catch a wink all night... Yawn...
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
It seems Грасс Вандер needs more
sleЭпизод
text_block_list.name: Монолог
